brief: Open-plan office with a long polished-concrete floor running along a full-height glazed window wall with roller blinds. At left, a glass-walled meeting room with thin black steel mullions holds a long meeting table and about eight black mesh task chairs. Beyond it, rows of white desks with monitors and mobile white filing pedestals line the window side, with more desks receding toward the back. Large potted palms and leafy plants in grey stone planters stand in the foreground and along the far wall. The ceiling is white and exposed, with ducted AC cassettes and slim linear pendant lights hung on rods. The mood is bright, airy, modern and corporate. Surfaces hold monitors, keyboards and a few small desk accessories.
